entry.title: New For Fall: The E Line Returns In 30mm And 38mm
entry.content:
Originally unleashed onto the scene in 1983, the Timex E Line made its mark with a rounded square case that earned an affectionate nickname: the “TV Dial.” More than four decades later, that distinctive shape is back with fresh proportions and new dial treatments.

 

Meet the latest E Line offerings, inspired by the 1983 original: a 38mm automatic and a smaller 30mm quartz, each carrying the character of the original into the present.

 

38mm Automatic: BOLD NEW CASE. SAME CLASSIC SHAPE.

The 38mm Timex Automatic E Line gives the original silhouette a more substantial presence on the wrist.

 

Its stainless-steel case frames a horizontally textured dial, available in silver-tone and teal. A vintage-style flat mineral glass crystal keeps the profile clean, while applied hour markers, a simple printed minute track, and a date window at 3 o’clock bring considered detail to the dial.

 

A brushed stainless-steel bracelet finishes the design, complete with a butterfly clasp that creates a seamless look on the wrist. And while the shape looks back to 1983, what’s ticking inside gives you another reason to keep it in rotation.

[SHOPPABLE_PRODUCT_BLOCK]

38mm Automatic: POWERED BY YOU

Inside the 38mm E Line is a self-winding Miyota caliber 8215 Japanese automatic movement with 21 jewels. Rather than relying on a battery, the movement harnesses the natural motion of your wrist to keep running and can store up to 40 hours of energy. Turn the watch over and an exhibition window in the case back offers a view of the movement at work.

[SHOPPABLE_PRODUCT_BLOCK_2]

30mm Quartz: NEW SIZE. SAME CLASSIC SHAPE.

For a smaller expression of the E Line, the new 30mm quartz models take the same rounded square silhouette in a different direction.

 

The compact stainless-steel case is paired with a lustrous sunray dial in pink or champagne, bringing a subtle shift in character as it catches the light. Applied hour markers, a simple printed minute track, and a vintage-style flat mineral glass crystal keep the design sleek and clean.

 

A brushed and polished stainless-steel bracelet with a butterfly clasp completes the smooth profile, while a reliable quartz movement keeps things simple.

[SHOPPABLE_PRODUCT_BLOCK_3]

ONE ICONIC SHAPE. TWO DISTINCT TAKES.

Automatic or quartz. 38mm or 30mm. Textured or sunray.

The newest reissue-inspired E Line offerings give an unmistakable Timex design from 1983 room to take on a new life. Each keeps the rounded square case at the center of the story, with thoughtful details that make the shape feel right at home today.

Because good design doesn’t need to shout to get your attention.

Sometimes, it just needs the right time to return.

entry.title: Cavatina Luxe: The Name Says It All
entry.content:
A New Take On Cavatina

Small watches have a way of making a statement without trying too hard. The latest additions to our Cavatina lineup embrace that idea with a slightly larger 22mm curved case, understated dial details, and a range of finishes and attachments that offers so many ways to style this retro mini.

[SHOPPABLE_PRODUCT_BLOCK]

PERFECTLY PETITE

At 22mm, the new Cavatina brings a little more presence to its signature petite profile. Its polished stainless-steel case follows a smooth, curved silhouette, complemented by a delicately domed mineral glass crystal.

 

The dial keeps things just as considered. Rather than filling the face with detail, two simple metallic hour markers at 12 and 6 o’clock give the design a clean, understated finish.

[SHOPPABLE_PRODUCT_BLOCK_2]

THREE DIALS, THREE DISTINCT LOOKS

Cavatina’s minimal design leaves room for its dial to do the talking. Glossy black enamel keeps things sleek and simple. Natural mother-of-pearl introduces an iridescent shine, with variations in color and luster that make each dial unique. And natural malachite brings rich, earthy color to the wrist, with distinctive striations that give every watch its own character.

 

Different by nature, each dial offers a new way to wear the same timeless shape.

 

MADE TO WEAR YOUR WAY

The choice continues beyond the dial.

 

Select styles feature a tarnish-free stainless-steel bracelet with curved links and a self-adjustable design that can be easily sized without tools. For a softer finish, our Cavatina is also available with a supple natural leather strap sourced from the Leather Working Group (LWG), promoting sustainable leather production.

 

Both options complement the watch’s petite proportions while giving it a distinct personality on the wrist.

[SHOPPABLE_PRODUCT_BLOCK_3]

TINY PROFILE. LASTING IMPACT.

With its curved 22mm case, domed crystal, minimal markers, and carefully considered dial and attachment options, the newest Cavatina proves that a watch doesn’t need to be oversized to get noticed.

 

Understated, elegant, and easy to make your own, it’s a small watch with plenty of ways to wear it.

entry.title: Q Timex Marbella: A Bolder Sense Of Time
entry.content:
Some designs are made to blend in. The new Q Timex Marbella collection takes a different approach.

 

A sharp reinterpretation of vintage sport style, the Marbella channels the confident, unconventional spirit that has defined Q Timex since the 1970s. Its strong geometry, contrasting finishes, and distinctive bolt details give the collection an architectural presence, while two case sizes bring that bold point of view to more wrists.

 

BUILT WITH BOLD DETAIL

The new 40.5mm Q Timex Marbella makes its presence known through an all-stainless-steel construction and carefully considered finishing.

 

A circular-brushed bezel is sharpened by polished edges and distinctive bolt details, creating a strong frame around a textured dial. Applied indices add dimension, while luminant in-fill on the hands and hour markers keeps the time easy to read long after the lights go down.

 

The collection includes a stainless-steel version with a textured blue dial as well as a two-tone execution pairing a textured black dial with a gold-tone bezel. Both are finished with fully brushed stainless-steel bracelets for a confident look from case to clasp.

[SHOPPABLE_PRODUCT_BLOCK]

ELEGANT LINES. EFFORTLESS CONFIDENCE.

The 34mm Q Timex Marbella carries the same unmistakable design language in a smaller proportion.

 

Its circular-brushed bezel, polished edges, and bolt details give the case a crisp architectural character, while applied indices stand out against a textured dial. Luminant hands and hour markers add visibility when the light fades.

 

The 34mm collection offers three distinct takes on the design: stainless steel with a textured silver-tone dial, two-tone stainless steel with a silver-tone dial and gold-tone bezel, and a gold-tone execution with a matching textured gold-tone dial.

 

Different finishes. Same confident attitude.

[SHOPPABLE_PRODUCT_BLOCK_2]

SHARP ’70S STYLE, RECONSIDERED

Q Timex was born during the quartz revolution of the 1970s, an era of experimentation that became one of Timex’s most prolific periods of design. Today, the collection continues to capture that innovative spirit by bringing vintage influences forward with modern updates.

 

Marbella fits naturally into that story. Its strong lines and considered finishing look back without feeling stuck in the past. The result is unmistakably Q Timex: bold, irreverent, and ready to stand apart.

entry.title: MK1® Chronograph: Classic Utility in an Elevated Form
entry.content:
Our MK1® Chronograph has always drawn inspiration from military field watches, valued for their straightforward design, dependable performance, and easy readability. Now, we've refined that familiar formula with thoughtful updates that bring a more elevated feel to an everyday classic.

[SHOPPABLE_PRODUCT_BLOCK]

Military Inspired. Everyday Ready.

The newest MK1® Chronograph introduces rich green and blue sunray dials that add depth and sophistication while preserving the clean, functional layout that has defined the collection. The result is a watch that transitions naturally from casual weekends to more polished occasions without losing its field-watch character.

 

Precision When It Counts

Inside the 40mm brushed stainless-steel case is a meca-quartz chronograph movement—a hybrid movement that combines quartz-powered timekeeping with a mechanical chronograph module to deliver a smooth sweeping second hand.

It's a practical balance of modern performance and classic watchmaking character.

 

Designed for Readability

Field watches have always prioritized legibility, and the MK1® stays true to that heritage. Large Arabic numeral hour markers and hands with luminant in-fill make the time easy to read in changing light conditions, while the clean dial layout keeps distractions to a minimum. A vintage-style domed acrylic crystal completes the look, giving the watch timeless character inspired by classic military timepieces.

[SHOPPABLE_PRODUCT_BLOCK_2]

Everyday Durability Meets Refined Style

The brushed stainless-steel case is crafted from tarnish-free stainless steel, offering lasting durability while maintaining a clean appearance through everyday wear.

Each model is paired with a supple black natural leather strap sourced from Leather Working Group (LWG) suppliers, supporting more responsible leather production. Contrast side stitching—green on the green dial model and blue on the blue dial model—adds a subtle finishing touch, while quick-release spring bars make changing straps fast and tool-free.

 

A Field Watch for Today

Instead of trying to reinvent the field watch, the MK1® Chronograph simply refines it.

With elevated sunray dial finishes, practical chronograph functionality, trusted readability, and timeless military-inspired design, it's built for people who appreciate utility without sacrificing style.

For those who want one watch that feels just as comfortable on a weekday commute as it does on a weekend adventure, the MK1® Chronograph is ready for every moment. Because great design isn't just about choosing between function and style, but about making both feel effortless.

entry.title: Retro Style, Modern Display: Meet the Timex Retroware Digital
entry.content:
Some designs never really disappear...they just find a new generation of fans.

The Timex Retroware Digital watch celebrates the unmistakable look of vintage digital sport watches while embracing the conveniences people expect today. With its oversized curved display, lightweight resin construction, and essential digital features, Retroware captures the spirit of the past without feeling stuck in it.

[SHOPPABLE_PRODUCT_BLOCK]

A Familiar Look with a Fresh Perspective

Inspired by the bold digital watches that defined an era, Retroware makes an immediate impression. Its oversized display features large, curved digits that are easy to read at a glance, while the rounded digital layout gives the watch a playful personality rooted in retro design.

Available in blue or grey-green, the lightweight 46mm resin case delivers strong wrist presence while maintaining a comfortable, barely-there feel for everyday wear.

 

Built for Everyday Life

Great design is only part of the story. Retroware is built with the everyday functionality that has made Timex digital watches trusted companions for decades.

A chronograph lets you track elapsed time, while the alarm and timer help keep your day on schedule. When the lights go down, the iconic INDIGLO® backlight makes the display easy to read, whether you're finishing a late workout or checking the time after dark.

These are the practical features people rely on, presented in a design that makes them feel fun again.

[SHOPPABLE_PRODUCT_BLOCK_2]

Comfort That Keeps Up

The lightweight resin strap is flexible enough for all-day wear and features quick-release spring bars that can be removed without tools, making strap changes simple whenever you're ready for a different look. Combined with the lightweight resin case, the result is a watch that feels as effortless as it looks.

 

Retro Style, Modern Display

Retroware is proof that great design doesn't have to choose between nostalgia and innovation. It brings together the bold character of classic digital sport watches with the everyday functionality Timex is known for.

Whether you're drawn to vintage-inspired design or simply appreciate a digital watch that's easy to wear and easy to use, Retroware delivers a fresh take on a timeless favorite. Because some classics deserve another moment, and some moments deserve a Timex.

entry.title: Automatic Power Meets Titanium Strength in the Expedition® Field Post Automatic
entry.content:
The Expedition Titanium Automatic is built for those who expect more from their gear. Combining a lightweight titanium case with a self-winding automatic movement, it delivers dependable performance without adding unnecessary weight to your wrist.

[SHOPPABLE_PRODUCT_BLOCK]

A Tougher Case That Feels Lighter

The 41mm case is crafted from black IP-coated titanium, giving the watch exceptional strength while remaining noticeably lighter than traditional steel. Its shock-resistant construction, protective crown guard, and 200m water-resistant design make it read to withstand the demands of the trail and beyond.

 

Turn the watch over and an exhibition case back reveals the automatic movement at work, putting its mechanical craftsmanship on full display.

Powered by Your Movement

Inside is a 21-jewel automatic movement that runs without a battery. Every step you take helps keep it powered, storing up to 40 hours of power reserve when fully wound. If it stops after being left unworn, simply wind the crown or wear it again to bring it back to life.

 

It's a movement that rewards wear, making it a natural companion for those who rely on their watch every day.

 

Built for Better Visibility

Outdoor conditions can change quickly, and the Expedition Titanium Automatic is designed to stay easy to read. Super-LumiNova® in-fill on the hands and hour markers improves visibility in low light, while a scratch-resistant sapphire crystal with an anti-reflective coating keeps the textured dial clear in bright sunlight.

 

A practical date window at 3 o'clock completes a dial that's designed for quick, confident reading.

 

Designed for Everyday Wear

The watch is fitted with a natural leather strap responsibly sourced through the Leather Working Group (LWG), combining everyday comfort with more responsible leather production. Quick-release spring bars make changing straps simple, allowing you to adapt the watch without tools.

Built to Go the Distance

Every element of the Expedition Titanium Automatic serves a purpose. From its lightweight titanium construction and battery-free automatic movement to its sapphire crystal, luminous dial details, and 200m water-resistant case, it's engineered for reliability without unnecessary complexity.

 

It's a watch that's in it for the long haul and built to earn its place on your wrist for years to come.

entry.title: Deepwater Meridian 200 Automatic GMT: Built for Underwater Adventure
entry.content:
When your watch is expected to perform everywhere from international travel to underwater exploration, reliability matters. The Deepwater Meridian 200 Automatic GMT is an automatic GMT watch designed to do more than keep accurate time. It combines battery-free mechanical performance, dual time zone functionality, premium materials, and durable construction in a timepiece that looks just as good on deck as it does down below.

 

Whether you're boarding a flight, heading offshore, or simply appreciating the craftsmanship of a mechanical watch, the Deepwater Meridian 200 Automatic GMT delivers the capability and durability to keep pace.

[SHOPPABLE_PRODUCT_BLOCK]

Why Choose an Automatic GMT Watch?

An automatic GMT watch offers two practical advantages in one movement. First, it eliminates the need for a battery by harnessing the natural motion of your wrist to power the watch. Second, it allows you to track two time zones simultaneously, making it ideal for travel, international business, or staying connected with friends and family across the globe.

 

Inside the Deepwater Meridian 200 Automatic GMT is a reliable 21-jewel automatic movement that winds itself as you wear it. Simply put it on, and your movement keeps working alongside you.

 

A dedicated 24-hour GMT hand tracks a second time zone, while the two-tone ceramic bidirectional rotating top ring makes reading that second time both intuitive and precise. Whether you're monitoring local time and home time or coordinating across continents, you'll always have both within view.

 

Built with 200m Water Resistance

Engineered with 200 meters of water resistance, the Deepwater Meridian 200 Automatic GMT is reinforced by a screw-down crown and screw-on case back that help protect the movement from water intrusion. Together, these features create a secure seal capable of withstanding pressures up to 20 atmospheres.

 

A sturdy crown guard provides additional protection against accidental impacts, helping preserve the integrity of one of the watch's most important components.

 

Whether you're diving beneath the surface, spending the day on the boat, or exploring the coastline, this GMT dive watch is designed to inspire confidence.

[SHOPPABLE_PRODUCT_BLOCK_2]

Premium Stainless-Steel Construction

Durability begins with materials.

 

The 42mm case combines brushed and polished stainless steel finishes to create a balanced look that's equally suited to outdoor adventures and everyday wear. Stainless steel naturally resists tarnishing and corrosion, helping the Deepwater Meridian 200 Automatic GMT maintain its appearance through years of use.

 

The matching 5-link stainless steel bracelet adds both comfort and refinement, while the butterfly clasp creates a smooth, uninterrupted profile across the wrist for a more elevated presentation.

 

Adventure often calls for versatility, which is why quick-release spring bars allow you to swap the bracelet for another compatible strap in seconds, without the need for special tools.

A Sapphire Crystal Built for Everyday Durability

The crystal is one of the hardest-working parts of any watch, and the Deepwater Meridian 200 Automatic GMT is equipped accordingly.

 

An anti-reflective sapphire crystal offers outstanding scratch resistance while reducing glare for improved readability in bright sunlight or underwater. A magnifier positioned over the date window beside 3 o'clock provides a clearer view of the date without compromising the clean layout of the dial.

 

Combined with the watch's premium construction, the sapphire crystal helps ensure long-lasting clarity wherever your adventures take you.

 

Enhanced Visibility in Low-Light Conditions

Whether you're diving, traveling overnight, or checking the time before sunrise, visibility is essential. Super-Luminova® on the hands and hour markers provides lasting illumination in low-light environments, allowing you to read the dial quickly and confidently when lighting conditions change.

 

The combination of luminous markers, anti-reflective sapphire crystal, and high-contrast dial design helps maintain excellent legibility throughout the day and well into the night.

Designed for Travel, Underwater Exploration, and Everyday Wear

One of the defining characteristics of the Deepwater Meridian 200 Automatic GMT is its versatility.

 

For travelers, the GMT complication keeps a second time zone close at hand. For divers and water enthusiasts, the 200m water-resistant construction provides dependable performance around the water. For everyday wear, premium finishing, mechanical craftsmanship, and thoughtful details make it a watch that's as comfortable in the office as it is on weekend adventures.

 

Instead of choosing between technical capability and refined design, the Deepwater Meridian 200 Automatic GMT delivers both.

 

A Mechanical Watch That Earns Its Place Every Day

Mechanical watches have long appealed to enthusiasts because of the craftsmanship they represent. Every movement is powered by precision engineering rather than electronics, creating a connection between the wearer and the watch that's both functional and rewarding.

 

The Deepwater Meridian 200 Automatic GMT builds on that tradition with practical features designed for modern life. Battery-free operation, dual time zone tracking, dive-ready durability, premium materials, and exceptional readability all work together to create a watch that's ready for years of dependable wear.

[SHOPPABLE_PRODUCT_BLOCK_3]

The Deepwater Meridian 200 Automatic GMT

From its automatic movement and GMT functionality to its stainless steel construction and 200m water resistance, every detail of the Deepwater Meridian 200 Automatic GMT is designed with purpose.

 

It's a watch built for those who appreciate thoughtful engineering, reliable performance, and timeless design. Whether you're exploring beneath the surface, crossing time zones, or simply enjoying the craftsmanship of an automatic movement, the Deepwater Meridian 200 Automatic GMT is ready for wherever time takes you.

entry.title: Todd Snyder x Timex Marlin Mesh: A Sleek Take On A Vintage Classic
entry.content:
Some watches tell time. The best ones remind you to slow down. 

[SHOPPABLE_PRODUCT_BLOCK]

For our latest collaboration with modern American menswear brand Todd Snyder, we looked back to one of the most enduring designs in the Timex archive—the Marlin—and reimagined it for the pace of summer. The result is the Timex x Todd Snyder Marlin Mesh, a fresh interpretation of a classic built for days that unfold a little more slowly.

Inspired by our vintage Marlin models from the 1960s and designed exclusively for Todd’s Spring/Summer 2026 runway show, the Marlin Mesh pairs our iconic mid-century silhouette with a finely woven, high-polished stainless-steel mesh bracelet—a distinct detail borrowed from one of Todd's favorite vintage watches.

[SHOPPABLE_PRODUCT_BLOCK_3] 

The sunray dials—available in silver, aqua, and salmon—draw inspiration from the cool blues of the Mediterranean and the warm glow of sunset along the coast. Polished hands and metallic Roman numerals at the quarter hours add just the right amount of refinement, recalling the kind of watch you might have spotted on the wrist of a well-dressed traveler somewhere along the Italian Riviera in the 1960s.

[SHOPPABLE_PRODUCT_BLOCK_2]

A vintage-style domed acrylic crystal preserves the character of the original Marlin, while inside, a reliable quartz movement delivers precise, everyday performance. The result is a watch that honors its heritage without feeling nostalgic, and a timeless essential designed to be worn often, packed everywhere, and appreciated more with every season.
